name: vwap_band_squeeze_5s
author: adapted from claude-4.6-opus
thesis: VWAP bands (VWAP ± k * rolling std of price) compress during periods of low intraday volatility, analogous to Bollinger Band squeezes. When band width contracts below the 20th percentile of its own session distribution, it signals coiled energy — a breakout is imminent. The inefficiency arises because most participants focus on price level relative to VWAP, not the width of the bands. The squeeze identifies moments when supply/demand is temporarily balanced but about to tip. The edge persists because band-width analysis on VWAP is not standard in retail TA, and the signal is rare enough (1-2 per day) that it is not worth automating for large funds.
mechanism: VWAP is the institutional execution benchmark. When spot deviates significantly from session VWAP, algorithmic execution engines increase order flow to mean-revert their fills toward VWAP. This creates measurable gravitational pull, especially during lower-volume mid-session periods when fewer competing flows are present.

exit.signal_exit: exit if vwap_bw_pctile rises above 60 (bands expanding means move is maturing)

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX between 12-22 (squeeze breakouts work best in moderate vol)

weaknesses: False breakouts from squeezes are common (~55% of the time); requires strict risk management
Signal is rare (1-2/day) which limits daily P&L and makes the strategy hard to scale
Band width percentile calculation requires sufficient session data — unreliable before 10:00 IST
prior_art: Bollinger Band squeeze (John Bollinger, 'Bollinger on Bollinger Bands') is the direct inspiration. TTM Squeeze by John Carter applies similar logic. Applying squeeze logic to VWAP bands rather than Bollinger Bands is a less common variant. Keltner-inside-Bollinger squeeze is a known alternative.
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
